review_method.full_panoramas: All six 5760x2880 source panoramas were reviewed through the Codex image viewer at a 2048x1024 display rendering.
review_method.entrance_windows: All six strict entrance-ray windows were reviewed at the original 1440x1680 crop size. The review windows used the already frozen plus/minus 45 degree horizontal and 45 degree above/60 degree below horizon contract, with native pixels and seam wrap.
review_method.allowed_evidence: Downloaded pixels, frozen OSM target-way/main-entrance geometry, frozen item pose metadata, and deterministic entrance-ray projection only.
review_method.forbidden_evidence: No OCR, CLIP, DINOv2, patch matcher, score, rank, threshold decision, or other learned-model output was viewed before this truth file was frozen.

episodes.observation: Both references show the Rumillat facade and name directly. The query is strongly foliage-occluded but the same grey-clad retail facade and its distinctive vertical service-text panel remain visible on the right of the entrance-ray window; the neighbouring Centre Salons facade is also visible as a distractor.

The low historic stone hall is present in both collections. The views differ sharply: the reference sequence exposes the gabled/stone facade and adjacent modern tower, while the query sees the hall obliquely through trees with the tower as a strong distractor. The target remains partly visible, so the row is retained as frozen rather than resampled.

claim_boundary.allowed: Human-visible same-target positive truth for this frozen two-episode, same-provider, cross-collection panel.
claim_boundary.not_allowed: The review does not prove portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint quality, arrival, handoff, user benefit, provider-disjoint generalization, deployment performance, or safety.
